drew_collections: FYI Sundial Therapeutics overdue INV-2026-621 for $19,200 hit final dunning notice today. ACH returned R29.
maria_billing: saw that. no card on file and balance flagged as high usage month. what do we want to offer?
kelly_support: customer replied to support: CFO says cashflow tight this quarter, asked for 60-day hold and proposed pay 25% now, 75% in 30 days. attached email.
sam_ops: webhook: {"return_code":"R29","tx":"ach_55432","amount":19200,"ts":"2026-03-20T14:22:11Z"} (logged)
drew_collections: policy: we can offer split with AR approval; must get signed installment agreement + autopay for remainder. Also require no refunds on upcoming renewals.
nina_sales: Sundial is mid-market lead; retaining them valuable. I'll ask for a brief waiver: waive one late fee if they enroll in autopay and provide signed agreement by 2026-03-25.
maria_billing: finance approves one-time late fee waiver conditional on signed agreement + card tokenization. need legal ok for renewal clause.
collections_bot: Action: invoice INV-2026-621 set to "pending_negotiation". Dunning paused until 2026-03-25.
drew_collections: I'll call CFO now and log verbal consent. If we get signed docs, schedule a 25% payment today via ad-hoc ACH retry; otherwise move to collections on 3/26.
kelly_support: emailed payment link and agreement template: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/installment-agreement. requested card for autopay.
nina_sales: CFO called back: agrees to 25% today via ACH retry and will sign agreement. asked for confirmation that service won't be interrupted.
drew_collections: logged MANUAL_RETRY scheduled 2026-03-21 09:00 PST. noted phone consent.
maria_billing: created AR watch ticket and set reminder 2026-03-26 to verify full resolution. assigning to drew_collections.
